layout.text: Quarterly maintenance report for building 14. The north stairwell lighting was replaced on March 3 and the elevator inspection passed with two minor notes. Invoice 48213 covers parts and labour totaling $2,917.40. Water damage near unit 7B requires a follow-up visit before April 21. Contact the facilities office at extension 5520 for scheduling. Keys for the roof access door are held by the night supervisor.
